Here is the step-by-step reasoning for the math problems:

**[id 240]**
John has 54 candies. He has twice as many as Robert, so Robert has 27 candies. James has 6 more than Robert, so James has 33 candies. John has 54 - 33 = 21 more candies than James.

**[id 241]**
There are 3 books in total (Dolly's 2 + Pandora's 1). Since both read all the books, Dolly reads 3 and Pandora reads 3. Collectively, they read 3 + 3 = 6 books.

**[id 242]**
Mike has 3 pen pals left. For each, he responds to 2 letters a week, each 5 pages long, totaling 10 pages per pen pal. With 3 pen pals, he writes 30 pages a week. At 6 minutes per page, that's 180 minutes, which is 3 hours.

**[id 243]**
Jason's calls with his boss take 15 minutes * 30 days = 450 minutes. Adding the 300 extra minutes to other people, he's used 750 minutes. Out of his 1000-minute plan, he has 1000 - 750 = 250 minutes left.

**[id 244]**
Griffin starts with 24 fries. Kyle takes 5 (19 left). Billy takes twice as many as Kyle, which is 10 (9 left). Colby takes 3 less than Kyle, which is 2 (7 left). After Ginger gives him some fries, he has 27. So Ginger gave him 27 - 7 = 20 fries.

**[id 245]**
The difference in snails is 32 - 4 = 28. This difference is twice the total amount of fish, so there are 14 fish in total. Divided equally between the 2 aquariums, each has 7 fish.

**[id 246]**
The makeup takes 6 hours a day * 4 days a week * 5 weeks = 120 hours. At $250 an hour, the total cost is $30,000. With a 10% discount ($3,000 off), Jean pays $27,000.

**[id 247]**
The total cost of party supplies is $12 (cake) + $43 (presents) + $15 (decorations) + $4 (invitations) + $22 (goodie bags) = $96. Split evenly among 3 people (Isabelle and her two parents), each person pays $32.

**[id 248]**
The chef bought 4 bags * 50 pounds/bag = 200 pounds of onions. At $1.50 per pound, the chef spent 200 * $1.50 = $300.

**[id 249]**
Sue's sister ate 5 cookies on Monday and 13 on Tuesday (18 total). Sue ate 4 times as many on Monday (20) and twice as many on Tuesday (26), totaling 46 cookies. Sue ate 46 - 18 = 28 more cookies. At 200 calories each, she consumed 28 * 200 = 5600 more calories.
